contract: Socket.IO outgoing stream_closed: closing a transcoded playback session answers 200, removes the stream folder and emits the session id once on every socket of the owning user; a close of a direct-play session, a rejected close, a second close of the same session and a close of an unknown session emit no such event.
exceptions: force is not applicable: closing is the only close mode; there is no forced or soft close variant.
The accepted playback lifecycle packet supplies scoped evidence; it also records that upstream can leave a child process alive on shutdown, which this packet does not assert.
The event is asserted as one argument (the session id string); the event order relative to user_session_closed is not asserted because the client reacts to either independently.

invariants.contract: Closing a transcoded session answers 200, removes the metadata/streams/<id> folder and persists the playback session row when listening time was synced, emits stream_closed with the session id exactly once on both sockets of the owner and on no admin or other-user socket.

A non-admin close of another user's session answers 403 and emits no stream_closed for either user and leaves the stream serving; closing a direct-play session emits user_session_closed but no stream_closed; closing an already closed session answers 404 with no second stream_closed.
